FROM publication_state s JOIN publication_release r ON r.id=s.live_release_id JOIN catalog_api_draft d ON d.id=r.api_id LEFT JOIN catalog_category_alias ca ON ca.category_key=r.category LEFT JOIN catalog_category c ON c.id=ca.category_id WHERE d.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND r.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.enabled=true AND r.status='APPLIED' AND (r.name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' AND COALESCE(c.id,r.category)=COALESCE((SELECT category_id FROM catalog_category_alias WHERE category_key=#{q.category}),#{q.category}) AND r.service=#{q.service} AND r.version=#{q.version} AND r.method=#{q.method} AND r.mcp_tool_enabled=TRUE AND r.lifecycle_status != 'RETIRED'

SELECT r.id,r.api_id,s.state_version AS effective_state_version,r.draft_revision,r.name,COALESCE(c.name,r.category) AS category, r.service,r.version,r.method,r.lifecycle_status,r.mcp_tool_enabled
ORDER BY r.service,r.version,r.method,r.id

SELECT COALESCE(c.name,r.category) AS category,COUNT(*) AS api_count
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.name,r.category) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.name,r.category)

SELECT r.id,r.snapshot_json,s.state_version AS effective_state_version,COALESCE(c.name,r.category) AS category FROM publication_state s JOIN publication_release r ON r.id=s.live_release_id JOIN catalog_api_draft d ON d.id=r.api_id LEFT JOIN catalog_category_alias ca ON ca.category_key=r.category LEFT JOIN catalog_category c ON c.id=ca.category_id WHERE d.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND r.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.enabled=TRUE AND r.status='APPLIED' AND r.service=#{service} AND r.version=#{version} AND r.method=#{method}
